description: Source code implementing JNI environment extension for Android, managing thread-specific JNI environment, class loader, and bridge object.

classes.name: JniEnvExt
classes.description: Extension class providing JNI environment management, including thread handling and class loading.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes JNI environment, sets up thread-local storage, and retrieves class loader and bridge references.

methods.name: OnThreadShutdown
methods.description: Detaches current thread from JVM if previously attached.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves or attaches the JNI environment for the current thread.

methods.name: GetStarboardBridge
methods.description: Returns the global reference to the starboard bridge object.

methods.name: FindClassExtOrAbort
methods.description: Finds a Java class using the class loader, aborting on failure.
